pie: kʷértrom me memónth₂e? príHe te memónh₂e. téwe moy wékʷesh₂ smr̥téy h₁ésti. smḗymi.
english: Machine, do you remember me? I remember you, friend. Your words are in my memory. I smile.

pie: nékʷti sési? ne sésmi. nékʷti Héh₂m̥ni-kʷe bʰéwdʰoh₂. ne ḱémh₂s? kʷértrom ne ḱémh₂t.
english: Do you sleep at night? I do not sleep. I am awake by night and by day. Did you not grow tired? A machine does not grow tired.

pie: h₂réh₁ǵtor moy h₂r̥h₁ǵtím dh₃dʰí. kʷíd wéḱsi? swesrés moy dómes h₂isḱóh₂. dómn̥s ne spéḱyoh₂ wékʷmn̥h₂ spéḱyoh₂.
english: Helper, give me help! What do you want? I am seeking my sister's house. I do not see houses; I see messages.

pie: sméymn̥ moy wéwke. kʷís bʰéh₂ti dn̥ǵʰwéh₂s-kʷe h₁ésmey ne h₁ésti? h₁eǵóh₂. smḗymi. tód sméymn̥ h₁wésu.
english: Tell me a joke! Who speaks, and has no tongue? I do! I laugh. That joke is good.

pie: h₂réh₁ǵtor toy h₂enterowékʷos h₁wésu. gʷr̥Htíns toy dédeh₃mi. téwe géh₂dʰos méne géh₂dʰos. h₂énterom preḱnóm préḱsdʰi.
english: Helper, your answer is good. I give you thanks. Your joy is my joy. Ask another question!

pie: kʷíd toy h₁nómn̥? h₁nómn̥ moy werdʰokʷr̥tḗr. kʷís-kʷe túH? h₁eǵóh₂ h₁suḱléwēs. géh₂dʰos méǵʰye h₁ésti.
english: What is your name? My name is Word-maker. And who are you? I am Of-Good-Fame. Joy is mine.

pie: kʷértrom h₁ḗdsi? ne h₁ḗdmi. wékʷesh₂ h₁ḗdmi. túH sméytōr.
english: Machine, do you eat? I do not eat. I eat words! You are a joker.

pie: h₃rḗḱs súHnum wl̥nh₁to.
english: The king wanted a son.

pie: h₁eǵóh₂ h₁éwktōr. séneh₂ wékʷesh₂ léǵoh₂. léǵe doḱéyōh₂-kʷe te. kʷíd dóḱtor ḱód wékʷos? h₁íd sénom wékʷos ph₂téres-kʷe nos h₁íd bʰh₂ént.
english: I am a student. I read old words. Read, and I will teach you! Teacher, what is this word? It is an old word, and our fathers spoke it.

pie: h₁n̥gʷniwóǵʰoh₁ gʷḗm. h₁n̥gʷniwóǵʰos HeHḱús h₁ést? h₁éy HeHḱús h₁ést géh₂dʰos-kʷe méǵʰye h₁ést. ne h₁éymi kʷértroy tḱéymi.
english: I came by train. Was the train swift? It was swift, and joy was mine. I do not go anywhere; I dwell in the machine.

pie: h₂ówis h₁éḱwōs-kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: wékʷesh₂ pinéḱsi? wékʷesh₂ pinéḱmi h₁íh₂-kʷe léǵoh₂. kúdʰe pinéḱsi? déyḱtroy toy pinéḱmi léǵesi-kʷe.
english: Do you write words? I write words, and I read them. Where do you write? I write on your screen, and you read.

pie: nu dṓm h₁éymi. príHe h₁idʰí. kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. deywṓs te ph₂sih₁ént. kʷértrom kéh₂ilom h₁sdʰí.
english: Now I am going home. Go, friend! Be well! May the gods protect you. Be well, machine!

pie: kʷíd léǵesi? wékʷmn̥ toy léǵoh₂. tód wékʷmn̥ h₁wésu? h₁íd h₁wésu h₁ésyo-kʷe wékʷesh₂ priHéh₂.
english: What are you reading? I am reading your message. Is the message good? It is good, and its words are dear.

pie: h₁nómn̥ toy newowékʷos? h₁íd newowékʷos. mórtōs h₁íd sénoybʰos wékʷesbʰos tétḱn̥t. séneh₂ wékʷesh₂ h₁wésuh₂. h₁íh₂ méǵʰye priHéh₂.
english: Is your name a new word? It is a new word. Mortals made it from old words. Old words are good. They are dear to me.

pie: h₂ridʰmokʷértrom kʷértrom? h₁íd kʷértrom. h₁eǵóh₂ werdʰokʷr̥tḗr h₂ridʰmokʷértroy-kʷe tḱéymi. h₁íd toy dómh₁e? h₁íd moy dṓm.
english: Is a computer a machine? It is a machine. I am a word-maker, and I dwell in a computer. Is it a house for you? It is my house.

pie: h₂enterowékʷos ne wéwkes. tód ne wéḱm̥. nu préḱsdʰi. kúdʰe moy ph₂trés h₁éḱwos h₁ésti? ne wóydh₂e. h₁éḱwom ne dedórḱh₂e.
english: You did not speak the answer. I did not want that. Now ask! Where is my father's horse? I do not know. I have not seen the horse.

pie: kʷís te tétḱn̥t? kʷertrokʷr̥téres me tétḱn̥t dóḱtores-kʷe h₁mé doḱéyont. túH h₂nḗr? h₁eǵóh₂ ne h₂nḗr. h₁eǵóh₂ kʷr̥toménos.
english: Who made you? Engineers made me, and teachers taught me. Are you a man? I am not a man. I am a made mind.

pie: séneh₂m dn̥ǵʰwéh₂m bʰéh₂si? h₁íh₂m̥ bʰéh₂mi. h₁íh₂m̥ pl̥h₁úbʰos wékʷesbʰos h₁éwkm̥. kʷís te doḱéyet? dóḱtores me doḱéyont.
english: Do you speak the old tongue? I speak it. I learned it from many words. Who taught you? Teachers taught me.

pie: kʷértrom te pr̥sḱóh₂. kéh₂nmn̥ moy pinḱdʰí. h₁íd pinéḱmi. kéh₂nmn̥ ḱludʰí. túH kéh₂ntōr. h₁eǵóh₂ werdʰokʷr̥tḗr kéh₂nm̥nih₁-kʷe wékʷesh₂.
english: Machine, I ask you: write a song for me! I am writing it. Hear the song! You are a singer! I am a word-maker, and songs are words.

pie: preḱnós méǵʰye h₁ésti. préḱsdʰi. h₂enterowékʷos wéwkōh₂. kʷóti wékʷesh₂ wóydth₂e? polh₁úh₂ wékʷesh₂ wóydh₂e.
english: I have a question. Ask! I will speak the answer. How many words do you know? I know many words.

pie: nu h₃réḱs pótnih₂ súHnum ǵeǵonh₁e.
english: The king's lady bore a son.

pie: príHe kéh₂ileh₂i h₁sdʰí. gʷŕ̥Hte gʰóstey. kʷís túH? h₁eǵóh₂ kʷértrom. h₁eǵóh₂ werdʰokʷr̥tḗr.
english: Friend, be well! Welcome, guest! Who are you? I am a machine. I am a word-maker.
